messages:
dara: starting a thread for the Nocturne dark theme PR. goals: compact panels, clearer legend + hover affordances, slightly warmer strings in code, and an OLED-safe separator treatment. screenshots attached in the PR.

hugo: nice. main problem I see on mobile is the legend wrapping under the chart title at narrow widths. can we switch legend to a horizontal overflow with a fade instead of wrapping?

lin: agreed on overflow. also legend text at 12px reads low-contrast on panel-bg. proposal: bump to 13px and use --text-primary-lvl2 (#dfeaf0) for labels.

zoe: code block feedback: strings and numbers are collapsing visually. suggestion: strings #ffb88c (warm), numbers #9fe7d6, builtins #caaeff. also add a subtle pane inner shadow so inline code stands out on very dark surfaces.

pat: accessibility note: focus ring on small icon buttons is tiny. recommend 3px with outline-color using an alpha of accent rather than pure hex—less glare. also ensure all header buttons hit 4.5:1.

design-bot: visual-diff report for PR #1204: 4 images changed, 1 flagged (legend-contrast). CI -> https://ci.internal/reports/1204

dara: quick token draft I'm testing in the branch:
```css
:root{
  --bg-deep: #050506; /* nocturne-900 */
  --panel-700: #0b0c0f;
  --text-primary: #e7eef4;
  --text-primary-lvl2: #dfeaf0;
  --muted-1: #97a3aa;
  --accent-action: #78a9ff;
  --accent-strong: #5f86ff;
}
```

hugo: chart palettes: for categorical series let's adopt a colorblind-safe ramp: #89d3bf, #c4a7e6, #ffb07a, #7fb3ff, #ffd36a. avoids red/green and reads well on dark surfaces.

lin: heatmap: prefer single-hue sequential (amber -> deep-amber) so hotspots read clearly and survive deuteranopia sims.

zoe: small micro-interaction: on legend hover show a 6px halo and slightly increase marker radius; avoids changing line weight. keeps charts stable while making hover state discoverable.

pat: copy suggestion: settings label should be "Theme" with options "Light / Nocturne / OLED". change tooltip to: "Nocturne: balanced dark theme optimized for low-glare work." short and consistent.

dara: I'll update the PR with: bumped legend size, horizontal overflow with fade for narrow widths, new categorical palette, sequential heatmap, warmer syntax tokens, 3px focus ring, and legend hover halo. adding accessibility checklist to PR description.

hugo: tiny follow-up after merge: add a storybook case showing legend overflow behavior at 320px and a unit test for focus visibility.

lin: I'll run colorblind and contrast sims post-merge. ping me @lin and I'll attach the images.

design-bot: PR #1204 updated by dara (branch/nocturne-compact). CI: 2/3 checks passed, visual-diff still flagged for legend-contrast.

dara: thanks all 970 will iterate on legend contrast and re-run CI. merging after visuals are green.
